authPanel.body: Join FreshPoint to shop fresh produce, manage wholesale orders and get quality essentials delivered to your door.
authPanel.brandLine: A OnePlan Enterprise brand · OrganicPoint / FreshPoint

login.heading: Log in to FreshPoint
login.intro: Log in with your phone, email or username and password.
login.error: We couldn’t log you in. Check your details and try again.

signup.heading: Create your account
signup.intro: Sign up with your email, add a phone number if you like, then log in with whichever you prefer.
signup.terms: I agree to the terms of service and privacy policy.
signup.error: We couldn’t create your account. Check your details and try again.

verify.heading: Verify your email
verify.introSuffix: Check your inbox and enter it below.
verify.codeError: That code isn’t valid or has expired. Request a new one.
verify.resendError: We couldn’t resend the code. Try again shortly.
verify.enterPassword: Enter your password to finish verification.

forgot.heading: Forgot your password?
forgot.notice: If an account exists for {email}, we’ve sent a 6-digit reset code. It expires in 10 minutes.
forgot.noEmailHint: Didn’t get it? Check your spam folder, or go back and try again with the same address.
forgot.intro: Enter the email you use with FreshPoint. We’ll send a reset code to your inbox — no phone or username needed.
forgot.error: We couldn’t send the reset email. Check the address and try again.

reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.doneNotice: Your password has been changed. You can now log in with your new password.
reset.intro: Enter the 6-digit code we emailed you and choose a new password.
reset.resendError: We couldn’t resend the code. Try again shortly.
reset.error: We couldn’t update your password. Check your code and try again.
reset.enterEmailFirst: Enter a valid email address first.

adminLogin.heading: Admin console
adminLogin.intro: Sign in with an authorised FreshPoint admin account.
adminLogin.error: We couldn’t sign you in to the admin console. Check your details and try again.

notFound.heading: This page went stale
notFound.body: We couldn’t find what you were looking for. Let’s get you back to fresh produce.
